title: Toddler Boy with Ball in Wicker Chair, 1960 B&W Indoor Snapshot
description: A charming black and white square snapshot taken in September 1960, capturing a 2.5-year-old toddler boy seated in a small wicker armchair. He is wearing a t-shirt, trousers, and leather baby shoes while holding a round rubber ball on his lap. The setting is a cozy carpeted room in front of draped windows, representing everyday mid-century American family life.
